text:
Irene (People Ops): FYI dropping a tiny manager calibration rubric + a 2-paragraph email template you can send to peers before calibration meetings. meant to cut prep time.

Marcus (Eng Manager): love it. can you include 3 anchor examples for performance bands? helps keep language aligned.

Irene (People Ops): sure 1) RUBRIC (one-liners for manager notes)
- Exceeds: consistently delivers beyond scope, measurable impact, mentors others. Evidence: shipping X that moved metric Y by Z%.
- Meets: owns commitments, predictable delivery, drives cross-team alignment. Evidence: delivered feature A on schedule and stabilized service.
- Needs growth: gaps in execution or collaboration; clear plan & timeframe for improvement. Evidence: missed rollout due to repeated infra issues; owned remediation plan.

Irene (People Ops): 2) CALIBRATION PREP (what to paste in the doc)
- Summary (1 line): role + one-sentence outcome + evidence link.
- Rating choice: Exceeds/Meets/Needs growth.
- 1-sentence rationale: specific example that justifies the rating.

Irene (People Ops): 3) PRE-MEETING PEER EMAIL (pasteable)
- Subject: Quick ask: peer input for calibration (name)
- Body:
  Hi <peer-name>,
  Were calibrating <employee name> for the upcoming review. Quick ask: could you share one short sentence about their cross-team collaboration and one sentence about execution reliability? Example: "Great at aligning infra timelines; took ownership of post-release fixes and reduced incidents by 40%."
  If you can reply by <date> that helps us finalize notes. Thanks!

Sam (IC): short and practical. can we get a neutral phrasing for "needs growth" so its not punitive in peers' replies?

Irene (People Ops): good call 1) Neutral peer prompt for growth context:
- "If any gaps stood out (handoff, docs, follow-through), can you describe one concrete example and suggested next step?"

Priya (Recruiter): could managers add a hiring signal line to the prep doc? helps us triage headcount.

Irene (People Ops): added HIRING SIGNAL (one line to paste): "Hiring suggestion (priority low/med/high): <role> because <one-line rationale>."

CalBot (calibration-bot): Reminder: paste prep 72h before calibration meeting (scheduled 1802160000).

Marcus (Eng Manager): awesome I'll use this and tag you if we need examples for IC vs. manager roles.

Irene (People Ops): thanks happy to add role-specific anchors (PM, SRE, Data) if you want.
